description:
Cast Earth Village Ruffians by paying its mana cost
When Earth Village Ruffians enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Earth Village Ruffians
When Earth Village Ruffians dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Village Ruffians enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.
